issue.title: following README.testbed.VsSetup.md fails with error ./setup-container.sh: line 49: j2: command not found

failure.body:
**Description** following sonic-mgmt/docs/testbed/README.testbed.VsSetup.md fails with error ./setup-container.sh: line 49: j2: command not found **Steps to reproduce the issue:** 1. Follow steps in [README.testbed.VsSetup.md](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/docs/testbed/README.testbed.VsSetup.md) 2. Until step [Run the setup-container.sh in the root directory of the sonic-mgmt repository:](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/docs/testbed/README.testbed.VsSetup.md#setup-sonic-mgmt-docker) **Describe the results you received:** 
❯ ./setup-container.sh -n sonic-mgmt -d /data
Using default image sonicdev-microsoft.azurecr.io:443/docker-sonic-mgmt
./setup-container.sh: line 49: j2: command not found
Build image docker-sonic-mgmt-mghoneim from /tmp/tmp.fLd6KdrF3y ...
unable to prepare context: unable to evaluate symlinks in Dockerfile path: lstat /tmp/tmp.fLd6KdrF3y/Dockerfile: no such file or directory
Creating container sonic-mgmt
Unable to find image 'docker-sonic-mgmt-mghoneim:latest' locally
docker: Error response from daemon: pull access denied for docker-sonic-mgmt-mghoneim, repository does not exist or may require 'docker login': denied: requested access to the resource is denied.
See 'docker run --help'.
Container creation failed, exiting
**Describe the results you expected:** ``` ❯ ./setup-container.sh -n sonic-mgmt -d /data Using default image sonicdev-microsoft.azurecr.io:443/docker-sonic-mgmt Build image docker-sonic-mgmt-mghoneim from /tmp/tmp.kvVJIRn7qC ... Sending build context to Docker daemon 7.68kB Step 1/9 : FROM sonicdev-microsoft.azurecr.io:443/docker-sonic-mgmt ---> f3ea45683cb9 Step 2/9 : RUN sudo groupadd -g 1000 mghoneim ---> Running in 0c4328a4fa89 Removing intermediate container 0c4328a4fa89 ---> 5449534c479d Step 3/9 : RUN sudo useradd --shell /bin/bash -u 1000 -g 1000 -d /home/mghoneim mghoneim ---> Running in e0e88e9c99de Removing intermediate container e0e88e9c99de ---> 4c678c346419 Step 4/9 : RUN sudo sed -i "$ a mghoneim ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" /etc/sudoers ---> Running in a7a0b252a422 Removing intermediate container a7a0b252a422 ---> f5c2c91c4efd Step 5/9 : RUN sudo usermod -aG sudo mghoneim ---> Running in 8aa36e3564f4 Removing intermediate container 8aa36e3564f4 ---> 8fc90f659b24 Step 6/9 : USER mghoneim ---> Running in 1e59df23fcc0 Removing intermediate container 1e59df23fcc0 ---> 10d7f81d661e Step 7/9 : ADD --chown=mghoneim id_rsa /home/mghoneim/.ssh/id_rsa ---> 895f521f237a Step 8/9 : ENV HOME=/home/mghoneim ---> Running in 978bde28e5fa Removing intermediate container 978bde28e5fa ---> 94ffe8eff28b Step 9/9 : WORKDIR /home/mghoneim ---> Running in a4bf33a68166 Removing intermediate container a4bf33a68166 ---> 589e34a671f4 Successfully built 589e34a671f4 Successfully tagged docker-sonic-mgmt-mghoneim:latest Creating container sonic-mgmt Verifying UID and GID in container matches host Done! ``` **Additional information you deem important:** using j2 was added to [setup-container.sh](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/setup-container.sh) very recently around 2 months ago (10/2020). It was introduced in this PR #2360 One solution is to install [j2cli](https://github.com/kolypto/j2cli), and add it as a step to [README.testbed.VsSetup.md](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/docs/testbed/README.testbed.VsSetup.md)

resolution.title: [testbed] Replace the install method of j2cli package
resolution.description:
### Description of PR
The j2cli package cannot be obtained from apt-get install.
Replace the apt-get install with pip install.

Summary:
Fixes #2696

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

When executing setup-management-network.sh, an error happend:

STEP 1: Checking for j2cli package...
j2cli not found, installing j2cli
Reading package lists... Done
Building dependency tree
Reading state information... Done
E: Unable to locate package j2cli

#### How did you do it?
Replace "apt-get install" with "pip install"

#### How did you verify/test it?

#### Any platform specific information?

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
